description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class for GuzzleHttp, implementing request retry logic with customizable delay and retry decision functions.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles retrying HTTP requests based on a decider function and supports exponential backoff delays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decider, next handler, and delay function.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing default exponential backoff delay in milliseconds based on retry count.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process a request with retry logic.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Handles successful responses, deciding whether to retry based on the decider.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Handles failed responses or exceptions, deciding whether to retry.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs a retry with calculated delay.
